card.name: Scattered words in academic and institutional text
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on assorted small words, ordinals and digits in institutional or academic web text, such as 'and' in an organization name or 'th' after 15.
card.plain: It has no clear trigger. It responds to a mix of small words in course, library and organization text.
